summary: MDA Space Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a C$600 million private placement of 6.50% senior unsecured notes due 2033. The offering, led by RBC Capital Markets, BMO Capital Markets, and Scotiabank, was sold to accredited investors in Canada and to QIBs in the U.S. under Rule 144A. Net proceeds will fund a portion of the previously announced acquisition of Blue Canyon Technologies LLC, expected to close by end of 2026. If the acquisition fails to close, MDA must redeem the notes at par plus accrued interest. Watch for acquisition completion and any redemption triggers.
